chunks: When they returned to their father, they said: 'O our father, a further measure has been denied us. So send our brother with us that he may bring more grain. We shall take care of him.'
ai.seo_question: What did Joseph's brothers tell their father Jacob to persuade him to let Benjamin go with them?
ai.summary: In this verse, Jacob’s sons return from Egypt withholding full grain measures, citing the Egyptian ruler's demand as the reason for their incomplete return. They petition their father Jacob to release Benjamin, offering a solemn guarantee of his safety, which highlights the tension between parental protectiveness and the necessity of survival during the famine. This moment sets the stage for the subsequent test of the brothers' character and the eventual reconciliation within the family.
